description: Get the Western (Revised Common Lectionary / Roman) liturgical season, liturgical color, RCL year (A/B/C), and any major feast for a date (defaults to today). Useful for date-aware, season-appropriate faith content. Daily readings are not included (those tables are licensed). No key required.

date.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today in UTC.

name: get_lectionary
